claim: § The generalization: 'The seam is always where a collaborator who interpreted is replaced by one who requires exactness' — claimed for any craft, tested only in BLUELINE until the 2026-10-19 music rough.

pieces.what: Hand the Groove, Loosened: tell a machine 'swing, laid back' and it plays straight; two authored numbers (swing ratio, backbeat lay-back) are the seam — plus the match-by-ear game Loudon called an ear-training quiz
One board record rendered at two fidelities (comic and grey-box) with a depth slider that round-trips — seam 1 as a handoff solved by design
Loudon's open reading made playable: push the swing past the norm until it stops reading as groove — where authorship lives between norm and breaking point (only if he takes the reading)
pieces.walks_up_from: the groove at the genre's default
